scope: Read-only primary-source and local capture inspection, not supplier quotation or venue selection

checks.finding: Hawksmoor Manchester Temperance private room seats 10–14. Separate semi-private spaces and menu service quantities are not this room capacity. The menu allows up to 20 individually served, not 20 private-room seats.
checks.effect: Do not pass the 15-practitioner-plus-other-distinct-people scenario based on a menu limit. Smaller scenario may remain only if actual total seats fit and privacy is acceptable.

checks.finding: The inspected lunch page gives £40 for two courses and £45 for three, per person. It does not establish a private-room minimum, complete drinks cost, current availability or all-in event budget. Tax/service basis is not stated on the inspected lunch page.
checks.effect: Retain as public food-price evidence with all missing terms unknown; not a zero tax/service input.

checks.finding: Benares Dover capacity 17–36 and Berkeley 11–16 are consistent in the PDF and website. Berkeley is unsuitable for an illustrative 17-seat total. Tasting menu is limited to 16 and therefore cannot simply price Dover at 17.
checks.effect: Keep room and menu applicability separate; a smaller host count is a scenario choice, not a capacity workaround or agreed staffing.

checks.finding: Benares £135 tasting and £78 Bayleaf prices explicitly apply 2 January–30 April 2026. Both are historical as at 30 October 2026. Both are VAT-inclusive with a 5% cover charge and 10% discretionary service described. The actual charging base and any compounding are not established here.
checks.effect: Exclude from a current-price budget unless clearly dated historical comparators; do not infer refreshed October rates or add VAT twice.

checks.finding: Benares larger-room minimum spend is on request. Published £800 and £1000 minima belong to smaller Chef/Sommelier rooms, not Dover or Berkeley.
checks.effect: Do not transfer small-room minima to selected larger rooms or turn unknown minima into zero.

checks.finding: Benares exclusive-hire seated capacity differs: website 100 versus PDF 150. This is outside the selected private-room screen.
checks.effect: Do not use the larger value. Log conflict and exclude the full-hire capacity from conclusions.

checks.finding: Corrigan’s Lindsay page records 24 boardroom and 40 reception capacity, no room-hire charge and an applicable food/drink minimum whose amount is on request.
checks.effect: Zero room hire is supported for this public mechanism; total room/hospitality cost is not zero and minimum, menu, date, service and tax remain unresolved.

checks.finding: A public room or menu page does not prove the chosen date, quote, acoustics, confidentiality, accessibility suitability, host workload, actual attendance or contractual terms.
checks.effect: These are discovery screens only. No venue recommended, contacted, held or booked.
